safeHtml:
'''Celestial Terrace''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the East Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-15.

History

Contrary to Intuition, the name of this District is not of Astronomical Origins. Instead, it is a lament of the developet of Asylum with regards to the high heavens taking away things that he liked.

Original plans of Celestial Terrace involved a School Village complete with Public Housing. However, after the School Village plans were cancelled, it was replaced by Public Housing in the form of Lei King Estate.

The north coast of Celestial Terrace, which is now known as Woodside Gate, is a large-scaled reclamation area. Only one Private Housing Project was planned in the vicinity of Woodside Gate, which is now called Territorial Bay. However, subseqeuntly, a new Interior Shopping Street is planned near the Promenade, and is one of the few Shopping Spaces in Asylum which involved two stories or more. Lei Ming Estate, located at the West of the Reclamation Area, is added on later planning stages. Several of the block also enabled views to the Woodside Gate Strait and East Point Bay, making that Estate one of the best Public Housing Estates in Asylum.

  • The Station Title of this Station is '''The Grandiose Gem'''.
  • This Stations features The Cuisine, and the Station Menu is "Beef Sliders with Pickles and Mustard".
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".

Station Characteristics

  • This station is the 300th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.
  • Similar to Midway Island Node Before it, this station is built entirely on an artificial island.
  • While the Builder of Nazca Railway had explicitly mentioned that this station would '''NOT''' be classified in any Station Class, the NR Dex of this station had shown that this station is of Terminal-class. As a result, the Station Usage column of this station writes Terminal.
  • Despite not containing the word Terminal, as the number of Platforms for all Standard Railway lines involved in this station is identical to that of Terminal-class Stations in the regards that each direction has two platforms, this station can be seen as a Terminal-class Station.
  • This Station features the first pair of Cross-platform interchange between two different Veloducts.
  • This Station has the second most number of Platforms behind Metropolis Terminal.

Fun Facts

  • This page is the 2600th page of this wiki.
  • The first background image of This Wiki was taken at the Premium Lounge of this Station.
  • This Station began construction on June 21 2020, but did not begin services until 17 days later on July 8 2020.
  • The Structure of this station had previously been plagiarised and appeared in another server.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=1857s</ref>
  • The Station Structure is 1100m long, and takes reference to Arsenal Bird, the boss in Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown. The reference is also evident from the fact that the North and South Wings of this station are named "Justice" and "Liberty" respectively, and the wingspan of Arsenal Bird is also 1100m wide.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=1887s</ref>
  • The Station Floors of this Station takes reference of an Airport with a Departure Concourse and an Arrival Concourse.
  • The North Wing and South Wing of this Station uses Blocks of Gold and Blocks of Diamond respectively. The Station Control Room of this Station is located at the Central Wing of the Arrival Concourse this station.
  • The Outdoor NR Shops and Outdoor Entry Gates of this station takes reference to Metro Stone Station and Greenrock Hill Stationhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=2712s</ref> and Aest Stationhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=2726s</ref> respectively.

Future Development

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline

  • will use this station as the Permanent Down Direction Terminus. From Here, it will extend to Xofa.
  • This Station will feature Local Rapid Transit services that may cover the entire Centopia Island.
  • will arrive at this station. However, facilities for will not be built until the development for begins for this station. The Platforms of may be placed below the , , , Platforms of this station, and would '''NOT''' go directly to Metropolis Terminal.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=2650s</ref>

title: Centopia Island
safeHtml:
'''Centopia Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. This island is an artificial island, is also the main island of the Centopia District, and is the first island involved in the Nazca Railway Headquarters.

Location

'''Centopia Island''' is located at the center of Centopia District. In terms of districts, it is located to the south of Peckern and the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent. In terms of islands, it is located to the southwest of Kioku Island, the east of Orama Island, the southeast of Hakeem Island and the northeast of Leben Island.

Transport

Railway

Centopia is the station that serves as the hub of this island, as well as the Nazca Railway Headquarters as a whole. It is currently served by , , , and , and will feature , an unknown Standard Railway line and an unknown Veloduct in the future, with possibilities of reaching it.<!--It may also feature the Headquarters LRT in the future.-->

Trunk Roads

Currently, this island features 6 different access roads, one in the form of Route 11 that provides connections from this island to Peckern to the north and Twenty-Second Continent to the south. Additionally, a road is also built by the developer of Twenty-Second Continent to access the Java Bay area, with access roads connecting to Kioku Island, Hakeem Island, Orama Island and Leben Island respectively.

Road

(To be added) <!-- Within this island, a road circumnavigating the island also exists, with various roads leading to and from the Pick-Up areas of vehicles. The roads on this island are named as follows:

Facilities

<!-- This island features a Station, a Depot, three parking lots, two marketplaces, two parks, a hotel and a trail that circumnavigates the island as follows: -->

Centopia

Centopia is the station that serves as the hub of this island. It is located at the center of this island in terms of the island length, and leans slightly to the west of this island in terms of the island width. It is also located to the south of North Parking Lot 2 and the west of Centopia Depot. Moreover, it also provides footbridge access to Orama Island.

Centopia Premium Lounge

Within the structure of Centopia lies Nazca Railway's first Premium Lounge, free for use of all passengers travelling to this island.

Centopia Depot

Centopia Depot is located to the east of the station structure of Centopia. It serves as the train base for and , and has a Capacity of 130 nine-carriage trains. It is also the Main Center of Operations for all lines in Los Sengas Division and is currently the largest depot in Nazca Railway.

North Parking Lot 1

The North Parking Lot 1 is located at the northwesterly side of the island beneath tracks and tracks to the north of Centopia. This Parking Lot features 1,300 Parking Spaces in total.

North Parking Lot 2

The North Parking Lot 2 is located directly to the south of North Parking Lot 1 and the north of the station structure of Centopia. The west part of this parking lot, above which the and tracks pass through, is similar to that of Parking Lot 1. However, the east side of this parking lot has four storeys that provides more parking spaces. A footbridge is also built connecting this parking lot with the flea market to the east.

Flea Market

The Flea Market is located to the east of North Parking Lot 1 and North Parking Lot 2, and to the west of Centopia Depot tracks and the North Park. This flea market features picnic tables to the west side starting from the North End to the Footbridge connecting to North Parking Lot 2, where tourists can rest after making purchases. From the South End to the aforementioned footbridge, the picnic tables are replaced by gardens instead.

It also features a total of 118 booths at the center, with three lavatories and benches at the east side close to the Centopia Depot, where tourists can make brief breaks during purchases. A tiny parking lot featuring a total of 60 Parking Spaces is also seen at the north.

South Park

The South Park is located at the southeasterly corner of the island to the east of Centopia Depot tracks. The South Park features three lavatories, one to its north boundary<!--with the Eastern Marketplace-->, one at the center and one to the south. This Park features a triangular garden to the west of the north lavatory, followed by a maze to its direct south.

To the south of the maze exists a rest area featuring the central lavatory at its west, rectangular picnic tables at its center and round picnic tables to its east, which in turn serves as a food court that is built in a fashion similar to Metropolis Phase III. At the south boundary of the park lies a fountain which is surrounded by a trapezium-shaped garden, and a tiny parking lot that serves this park also exists across the road that connects this island with Leben Island.

North Park

The North Park will be located at the northeasterly side of the island to the east of Centopia Depot tracks.

South Parking Lot

The South Parking Lot will be located at the southwesterly side of the island to the south of the hotel.

Hotel

The Hotel will be located directly to the south of the station structure of Centopia and to the north of South Parking Lot. <!--It has also reserved space for the future Headquarters LRT.--> <!--

  • The Name of this island would be used in a movie of The Same Name. However, the naming of this island and that movie are not related to each other.
  • The channel that exists between Kioku Island to the northeast and this island is 150m wide.
  • The channel that exists between Orama Island to the west and this island is 400m wide.
  • Except for Centopia, Centopia Depot, North Parking Lot 1 and North Parking Lot 2, all other facilities on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas due to slow development progress.

Definition

The early definition of Checkpoints were inconsistent, as was defined partly due to its pioneering test of new station facilities. However, since and are defined as checkpoints, the definition has since been clearer.

In 2020, Nazca Railway has described the requirements for a station to be defined as Checkpoints, including the potential for developments around the station, choices inside and outside railway network and districts connected by the station. Simply taking choices for interchanging inside the railway network, all Checkpoints now feature at least 4 lines, either having services upon completion of station or planned to serve in future. Though, this is not the only requirement to categorize a station as Checkpoint, nor a must.

'''Circle Pit Station''' is a station on and . It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Ingress. Passengers may also use this station to change to Mushroom Transit , (Circle Pit Station).

Station Floors and Facilities (Description)

North Concourse

The North Concourse is a Concourse directly belonging to , and is the only concourse among the four concourses to be located at Ground Level. The North Concourse has an elevator and a set of stairs connecting to the Platforms, with direct access to the East Concourse at the Non-Entry Gate Area. The North Concourse has a Minecart claim area, a recycle bin, 4 shops and station facilities, with Access to Exit A.

East Concourse

The East Concourse is a Concourse that also directly belongs to . This concourse is situated to the east beneath the Platforms. The East Concourse has three sets of stairs and two elevators connecting to the Platforms. Inside the Entry Gate Area are two shops, a Minecart Claim Area and Station Facilities, and outside the Entry Gate Area are recycle bins. Between the Passageway to two elevators is a branch that connects to a toilet, with direct access to the North Concourse at the Non-Entry Gate Area. Moreover, a Corriodor exits at both inside and outside the Entry Gate Area connecting to the South Concourse. The East Concourse features Exits B1 and B2, with these two exits being stair exits and elevator exits respectively.

West Concourse

Similar to the above two concourses, the West Concourse also directly belongs to . This concourse is at the same Depth (Y Coordinaets) as the East Concourse, except that this concourse is located to the West. The West Concourse has two sets of stairs and an elevator connecting to the Platforms. The Non-Entry Gate Area only occupies a quarter of the surface area of this concourse, with no direct access to other concourses outside the Entry Gate Areas. The West Concourse features Station Facilities, Los Sengas Coffee and three shops, featuring Minecart Claim Areas and Recycle Bins in and out of the Entry Gate Area. A passageway connecting to the center of the South Concourse also exists in the Entry Gate Area. The West Concourse Features Exit C, which is simultaneously an elevator exit and a stairs exit.

South Concourse

The South Concourse is a Concourse that directly belongs to . Among the four concourses, this Concourse is the Largest, and is also the only concourse that adopts a significantly different color scheme from the other Concourses. The structure of the South Concourse is similar to other underground Nazca Railway Stations, and is as wide as the Platforms beneath it while being only 90% of its length. The South Concourse has four sets of stairs and an elevator connecting to the Platforms, featuring a single entry gate area and two unconnected Non-Entry Gate Areas. While the Non-Entry Gate Area to the South features Exits D and E, the North Non-Entry Gate Area features Exit F and access to the East Concourse. Moreover, passageways to the East and West Concourses also exist within the Entry Gate Area, complete with all Basic Station Facilities, Minecart Claim Areas, Recycle Bins, Station Teleportation and the Station Control Room. Since the completion of the Mushroom Transit Circle Pit Station, Exits G1, G2 and G3 are also connected to this Concourse, with Exits G2 and G3 being inside the Entry Gate Area, and G1 being outside the Entry Gate Area.
